(210, 60) — proven: Oleg at the machine 2026-08-05: 'material is 210c btw pla'. machine.LOADED had read pla-matte since 07-27, so every K2 file commanded 230 on filament rated 210 and a tower coiled into a rope; at 210 the identical geometry stood. Bed 60 is the mid of the filament's rated 50-70 and the minimum that works -- 0 gave 'spagetti, no adhesion' twice and 120 held PLA above Tg so a pressed floor never set.
